description: Whose an address is, as far as anyone has said: an exchange, a market maker, a custodian, a fund or a thief (from the exchanges’ own published wallet lists, Dune’s exchange tables and the eth-labels set, with which named it), the token whose contract it is, or an unnamed whale among the ten largest holders of top tokens; and the top tokens it is among the largest holders of, with share and value. Covers EVM chains best; Bitcoin, Solana and Tron addresses are mostly unnamed. Nobody having named an address says nothing about its owner. Use when someone pastes an address and asks whose it is, whether it is an exchange, or who received a transfer.
